_comment: PHISHING MODEL WEIGHTS - HEURISTIC BOOTSTRAP, NOT A TRAINED MODEL.
These coefficients were hand-initialised so the service is runnable before a
training run has happened. The signs reflect directions established in the
literature (Ma et al. KDD 2009; Sahoo et al. 2017) but the magnitudes are NOT
fitted to data and the output is NOT probability-calibrated - it saturates
towards 0 and 1 more readily than a trained model would.
DO NOT REPORT ACCURACY, PRECISION, RECALL OR F1 FROM THIS FILE. Any metric
quoted in the project report must come from a genuine training run.
Replace by running:  python scripts/train_phishing_model.py --data data/urls.csv
That script overwrites this file with provenance set to TRAINED and fills in
the metrics block from a held-out test split.
featureNames order is contractual and is validated at startup against
UrlFeatureExtractor.FEATURE_NAMES. Do not reorder by hand.

metrics._note: Empty by design. A bootstrap model has no measured performance.
